text.original: Learn about Aurelia Estates, a private Los Angeles brokerage founded on discretion, design literacy, and long-term client relationships since 2014.
A brokerage built on discretion and design

Aurelia Estates was founded in 2014 by Adriana Voss, a former private art advisor who spent a decade helping collectors navigate discretion, provenance, and value — skills she found were just as essential in real estate. She started the firm after watching too many exceptional Los Angeles properties change hands through impersonal, transactional processes that ignored what her clients actually cared about: privacy, craftsmanship, and trust.

Twelve years later, Aurelia Estates represents some of the most significant addresses in Bel Air, Holmby Hills, and Beverly Hills, and along the Malibu coastline, with select advisors extending our reach into Aspen and the Hamptons. Every advisor at the firm has closed nine-figure transactions and understands that a $10 million sale demands the same care as a $50 million one.
We remain independently owned and deliberately small. Six advisors, one standard: represent every client as though the transaction were our own.
Confidentiality agreements, private showings, and a strict no-sign policy for qualifying properties.
Our advisors can speak fluently about architecture, provenance, and craftsmanship — not just square footage.
Most of our business comes from repeat clients and referrals within a tight, trusted network.
We know every canyon, cul-de-sac, and coastline in our markets, while connecting clients to opportunities well beyond them.

text.original: Bel Air Modern Compound | Aurelia Estates
1685 Stradella Road, Bel Air, Los Angeles, CA — a 6 bedroom, 8 bathroom modern architectural compound represented by Aurelia Estates.
1685 Stradella Road, Bel Air, Los Angeles, CA 90077

Set behind private gates on one of Bel Air's most coveted streets, this newly built compound pairs museum-quality architecture with effortless indoor-outdoor living. Walls of pocketing glass open the main living pavilion to a motor-court auto gallery, a 70-foot infinity-edge pool, and unobstructed canyon views. The primary suite occupies its own wing, with a private terrace, dual dressing rooms, and a spa bath finished in book-matched marble. A subterranean level houses a screening room, wine cellar, and wellness center with sauna and cold plunge.
